environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: All 24 Kodak photos resized to width 512 without enlargement. Four Sharp encoder configurations at q50/65/75/85/95; three sequential passes with reversed codec order on odd passes. Timings include decode/resize/encode, exclude disk reads, SSIM and validation. Every repeated output digest must match. SSIM.js 3.5.0 fast algorithm, original luminance conversion, no downsampling, 11px Gaussian window; reference is the identically resized uncompressed RGB image. SSIM is a luminance metric, not a human quality verdict; numeric qualities are not equivalent across codecs. Codecs use Sharp defaults except quality and JPEG mozjpeg flag. This is a codec tradeoff, not evidence of a package-level speedup.
